cases.title: Industrial innovation support programme
cases.description: Eligible applicants must be manufacturing SMEs operating in the drone sector and have at least one drone product at TRL 6.

cases.title: Industrial heat recovery for drone component factories
cases.description: Companies may demonstrate waste heat recovery in an industrial furnace. No proprietary drone product is required.

cases.title: Green transition in a manufacturing value chain
cases.description: Applicants are SMEs in the textile value chain. SMEs from complementary sectors such as technology and machinery are also eligible when their innovation contributes directly to the value chain.

cases.title: Cross-border cooperation networks
cases.description: The call is open exclusively to cluster organisations, digital innovation hubs and regional development agencies. Funding covers joint strategies, expert pools and networking.

cases.title: Cluster-led industrial pilot programme
cases.description: The call is open exclusively to cluster organisations and digital innovation hubs and regional development agencies. Funding to member companies covers costs and pilots implemented by member companies.

cases.title: Cross-border industrial innovation
cases.description: Clusters, companies and research organisations may apply. Industrial SMEs receive grants for their own pilot costs.
